guidance.text: A financial institution must screen all parties to a payment against the lists it is subject to, escalate a possible match to a compliance officer, and never clear a match without a documented human decision (fictional procedure summary).
Where a name match is identified, the institution retains the underlying evidence, records the disposition rationale, and applies dual review to a confirmed designation (fictional procedure summary).
A reporting entity assesses the match against beneficial-ownership information and documents whether the party is the true designated person before proceeding (fictional procedure summary).
